Subject: Private deployment maintenance syncboard — preflight & rollback plan

Hi Priya / MedSecure Ops,

Thanks again for taking the time to sync on Private deployment maintenance. We're proposing a short, low-risk maintenance window to apply a targeted runtime patch and a minor version bump for the Private control plane components that live in your VPC. High level:

- Proposed window (initial): 2025-04-22 01:00–03:00 UTC
  - Canary: 01:00–01:30 UTC against a single shard
  - Gradual rollout: 01:30–02:30 UTC across remaining shards
  - Observability + rollback hold: 02:30–03:00 UTC
- Scope: runtime micro-patch (v1.4.2 -> v1.5.0-rc), control-plane agent restart, KV cache refresh for pinned sessions only
- Expected customer impact: negligible for pinned customers; we will route traffic off nodes during drain windows and warm caches before serving

Before we lock the date we need:
1) Confirmation of canary shard (which AZ/cluster you prefer).
2) Any blackout windows on your side during the proposed UTC times.
3) Pointer to the compliance evidence owner who will want the change log / pre/post telemetry for the SOC2 artifact.

Attachments: vpc-rollout-matrix.xlsx (detailed sequence), rollback-commands.txt (immediate commands).

I'll loop in Aditya for the technical runbook and Marissa for scheduling and external comms.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Director, Cloud Operations
Redwood Inference

- Blackout windows: avoid 13:00–17:00 UTC (billing batch runs) and 00:00–00:30 UTC (maintenance snapshot). The proposed window looks OK otherwise.
- Compliance: please send the pre/post telemetry and change list to compliance@medsecure.com; they'll need a short summary for our SOC2 evidence package.

Also can you enumerate the abort criteria? We operate strict recovery SLAs for patient-facing flows.

Subject: Re: Private deployment maintenance syncboard — preflight & rollback plan

Thanks Priya — quick runbook + abort criteria below (technical):

Planned steps (canary -> full):
1) Canary pin: deploy v1.5.0-rc to production-shard-2 only; preserve customer-level pins.
2) Warm KV cache: runKVWarm.sh --shard=production-shard-2 --duration=5m
3) Gradual agent restart per host with 5m drain + health-check window.
4) Validate latency & error budget against the baseline for 15 minutes post-canary.
5) Proceed to next shard if metrics OK; otherwise call immediate abort.

Abort criteria (immediate rollback if any of the below):
- 5xx rate increase > 0.5% absolute for 5m
- P95 latency > baseline + 200ms for 10m
- KV hit-rate drop > 7% sustained for 10m
- Any customer-reported production error for patient-facing flows

Rollback plan (fast path):
- Command: rollback-controlplane --shard <shard> --to v1.4.2 
- If rollback fails on a host, isolate host (cordon) and shift traffic: kubectl label node <node> cordoned=true && route-update --remove-node <node>
- Post-rollback: run forensic logging capture: /opt/redwood/bin/capture-forensics --shard <shard> --since 01:00Z

Operational notes:
- Network drain: we'll request a brief BGP withdrawal for the node IPs; please confirm NAT / firewall ACLs allow health-check probes from our probe IPs (listed in the drive doc).
- Telemetry: we will publish pre/post traces and token-level cost breakdown to the shared drive folder.
- Timings: expected per-shard median outage during drain ~ 20–45s for in-flight requests (we will serve from fallback nodes where possible).

Attachments: vpc-rollout-matrix.xlsx, rollback-commands.txt
Related: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/OPS-4321, https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcXyZ-example

--
Aditya Rao
